name: Scroll Choreography

heroIndex.description: Which of the 4 items grows to fill the viewport.

spread.description: Outward drift of the supporting images, in vw.

startRadius.description: Corner radius of the hero at the start of the track, in px; eases to 0.

captionAt.description: Track progress (0-1) at which the caption starts fading in.

smoothing.description: rAF lerp factor applied to the scroll progress each frame.

a11y: The four images are decorative unless the author labels them; the DOM order never changes, so reading order is unaffected by the visual scale and drift.
The caption is real text in normal flow, on a gradient scrim over the hero for >=4.5:1 contrast.
Nothing traps scroll or keyboard focus; the pin releases once the track ends and the page scrolls on normally.
A host without exactly 4 ".genui-scroll-choreography__item" children logs a console warning and mount is a no-op, so a malformed demo never leaves the section pinned or hidden.
